say:1:1130325001:1.text: Orson died a warrior's death, fighting for the glory of the clan. I will honor him for all time.
say:1:1130325001:1.source_cn: 奥格的死是战士之死，他为了氏族的荣耀而亡，我们会永远敬仰他。
say:1:1130325001:1.male: Orson died a warrior's death, fighting for the glory of the clan. I will honor him for all time.
say:1:1130325001:1.female: Orson died a warrior's death, fighting for the glory of the clan. I will honor him for all time.

say:2:1130325002:1.text: I will never respect Soren or the Uru Clan!
say:2:1130325002:1.source_cn: 索恩和乌尔氏族，我会永远与他们为敌！
say:2:1130325002:1.male: I will never respect Soren or the Uru Clan!
say:2:1130325002:1.female: I will never respect Soren or the Uru Clan!
